# log-anomaly-score

> Score anomalies in per-bucket log counts with robust z-scores over a trailing window: median and MAD baselines, spikes, drops, new keys and bounded JSON state Python package `trysac-log-anomaly-score`, import name `log_anomaly_score`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
